query:
WITH RECURSIVE subtree AS (
            SELECT id
            FROM nodes
            WHERE id = $1 AND user_id = $2
            UNION ALL
            SELECT child.id
            FROM nodes child
            JOIN subtree parent ON child.parent_id = parent.id
            WHERE child.user_id = $2
        )
        SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM subtree WHERE id = $3) AS "exists!"
